name: point_in_time
title: 严格时点特征
question: 已知数据滚动特征
example_sql:
WITH anchors AS (SELECT u.uid,u.region,c.day FROM units u JOIN calendar c ON c.day=24 WHERE u.uid BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
visible AS (SELECT a.uid,a.day anchor_day,m.rid,m.event_id,m.day,m.received_day,m.revision,m.valid,m.v,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY a.uid,a.day,m.event_id ORDER BY m.revision DESC,m.rid DESC) choice FROM anchors a JOIN observations m ON m.uid=a.uid AND m.day BETWEEN a.day-8 AND a.day-1 AND m.received_day<=a.day),
picked AS (SELECT * FROM visible WHERE choice=1 AND valid=1),
attr_versions AS (SELECT a.uid,a.day,b.aid,b.recorded_day,b.scale,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY a.uid,a.day ORDER BY b.recorded_day DESC,b.revision DESC,b.aid DESC) choice FROM anchors a LEFT JOIN attrs b ON b.uid=a.uid AND b.valid_from<=a.day AND b.valid_to>a.day AND b.recorded_day<=a.day),
features AS (SELECT a.uid,a.day,a.region,COUNT(x.v) n,COUNT(x.event_id) n_rows,SUM(x.v) val_sum,AVG(x.v) mean_val,VAR_POP(x.v) var_val,MIN(x.v) min_val,MAX(x.v) max_val,MAX(x.received_day) max_received,MAX(x.revision) max_revision FROM anchors a LEFT JOIN picked x ON x.uid=a.uid AND x.anchor_day=a.day GROUP BY a.uid,a.day,a.region)
SELECT f.*,b.aid,b.recorded_day,COALESCE(b.scale,CAST(1 AS DOUBLE)) attr_scale,l.y label_y,l.ready_day FROM features f LEFT JOIN attr_versions b ON f.uid=b.uid AND f.day=b.day AND b.choice=1 LEFT JOIN labels l ON l.uid=f.uid AND l.day=f.day+1 AND l.ready_day<=24 ORDER BY f.uid,f.day
